trajectory_summary: The call opens with unusually high customer energy — he asks how the process works before being asked anything — and the rep rides that energy to a Saturday booking with minimal resistance. But the rep never resolves who legally owns the home, skips the interest-question entirely, and lets a competitor-bankruptcy disclosure pass without any probe, leaving real gaps under a smooth-sounding close.

observed_outcome.quote: But, yeah, I can have someone meet with you this Saturday at 02:00.
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day and time (Saturday 2:00) were agreed by the customer ('Perfect'), but the actual homeowners (parents) were never confirmed to attend.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The bill (1348 kWh) was captured at 03:11 but never turned into an emotional or alignment-against-utility hook; the flip should have landed right after 04:10 when the rep sent the text, e.g. tying the usage number to potential savings before moving to logistics.
